_comment: In-game text for CTF in the seven cultures Bodycam ships. 'en' is the SOURCE string: it must be byte-for-byte what the mode row / Blueprint carries (make_pack checks Title/Description against manifest.json). The hub merges these into the player's own Game.locres per culture at install time (namespace CommunityGamemodes). Card title in the game's own Title Case style (Sam, 2026-09-14: 'follow the game's title case style' — like 'Team Deathmatch'); HUD marker labels stay in capitals. Translations by Claude, 2026-09-14 — corrections welcome, edit and re-pack.

CTF.Description.en: Return the enemy flag to base to win. [2.5X DRONE COOLDOWN]
CTF.Description.de: Bringe die feindliche Flagge zu deiner Basis, um zu gewinnen. [2,5-FACHE DROHNEN-ABKLINGZEIT]
CTF.Description.es: Lleva la bandera enemiga a tu base para ganar. [ENFRIAMIENTO DE DRON x2,5]
CTF.Description.fr: Ramenez le drapeau ennemi à votre base pour gagner. [TEMPS DE RECHARGE DU DRONE x2,5]
CTF.Description.pt: Leve a bandeira inimiga até a sua base para vencer. [RECARGA DO DRONE 2,5X]
CTF.Description.ru: Принесите флаг врага на свою базу, чтобы победить. [ПЕРЕЗАРЯДКА ДРОНА 2,5X]
CTF.Description.zh: 将敌方旗帜带回己方基地即可获胜。[无人机冷却时间 2.5 倍]
